tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per the RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have experience in development and maintenance of Inventory Management / Material Management and Vehicle Management to any one of the State run Transport Undertakings / Transport Undertakings run by local Civic Authorities during the last 5 years (at least one project).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of Work Orders/ Purchase Orders/ Contract Documents
Others -- Project Completion and Satisfactory Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be Incorporated or registered in India under the Indian Companies Act, 1956/ 2013, or LLP with registered office in India.Should have been in operation for the last 3 financial years from the date of publishing of RFP notice in the area of Digital Platform Implementation/ System Integration/ IT Services Implementation.Registered with GST Authorities in India.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Registration or Incorporation issued by the competent authority.
Others -- Purchase Orders showing at least specified no. of years of operations or copy of balance sheet and P&L statements for the specified number of years
Others -- Copy of Registration Certificates with the GST Authorities.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have valid certificates related to:ISO 9001:2015 or higher Quality Management.ISO 20000-1:2018 or higher IT - Service Management.ISO 27001:2013 or higher Information Security Management System

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- ISO 9001:2015 or higher Quality Management
Others -- ISO 20000-1:2018 or higher IT - Service Management
Others -- ISO 27001:2013 or higher Information Security Management System

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not have been blacklisted or debarred by any Government/ PSU/ STU/ Corporation/ Smart City SPV in India as on bid submission date.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-declaration by the bidder duly notarized and signed by the authorized signatory on Non judicial stamp paper of appropriate value.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have minimum average annual turnover of INR 01 Crores for continuous three preceding years out of four years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Audited financial statements for the years 2022-23

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have positive net worth in the last preceding continuous three years out of four years (i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 202526).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate duly signed by Statutory Auditor or Certificate from Chartered Accountant clearly stating the net worth.
